rules.rationale: Both signals indicate low failure likelihood; low output
Relative signal is low; moderate absolute usage is insufficient to indicate failure
Relative signal is low; high absolute telemetry represents healthy workload, NOT failure
Moderate relative deviation observed without absolute saturation; alert remains moderate
Moderate relative deviation accompanied by moderate absolute resource load; moderate alert
Moderate relative deviation reinforced by high absolute resource usage triggers high alert
Strong relative deviation indicates failure regardless of absolute baseline
Strong relative deviation accompanied by moderate load confirms failure
Both relative change and absolute saturation confirm impending failure
